lifecycle.event: same authorized request, binding current, identical body
lifecycle.result: Retained exact outcome; replayed=true; do not reapply, downgrade newer UI projection or revalidate new revision in place of captured revision.
ReplayConflict before any dependency IO; no new ordinal to evade conflict.

lifecycle.event: old binding closed, writer transferred or window instance replaced
lifecycle.result: Validate caller/instance/binding first: UnauthorizedCaller or MissingBinding or StaleOwner; old runtime result is not disclosed to new authority. No resubmit on fresh binding.
Owner finishes already admitted operation under captured authority only; keep evidence/Held. No delivery to stale window. New binding cannot claim same runtime request.

lifecycle.event: process restart or runtime record missing
lifecycle.result: UnverifiedOutcome if admitted request cannot be authenticated in current runtime; old binding normally MissingBinding first. No automatic mutation retry or recreation. Durable issuer lookup is internal authenticated reconciliation only, not new H2 command.

lifecycle.event: authenticated durable material lookup succeeds after restart
lifecycle.result: May establish material transition only; cannot establish runtime install/Undo success or ACK. Fresh owner open and explicit new intent required; prior uncertainty remains recorded.
AppliedRetentionDeferred with original revisions, pin and mutation proof; never rollback, unchanged failure, automatic release or fabricated success.

postcommit_stage: LiveRoots for install; UndoRoots for Undo outgoing retention; RedoRoots for retained redo root, according to actual failed root target. Multi-root failure reports first failed stage in declared order LiveRoots,UndoRoots,RedoRoots; retain all unresolved pins.
uncertainty: UnverifiedOutcome does not assert zero changes. UI shows outcome unknown and requires reconciliation, preserves draft and disables blind retry. Other precommit failures assert zero content commit only when commit is positively known not attempted.
